unstuck_said.text: Filed issue #1 on arturete58-sys/x402-observatory: "Add Nano (XNO) exact-scheme settlement to the delivery-verification semantics - the block is the receipt". Framed in its buy-and-verify method: a Nano block is the self-verifying receipt, re-derivable by anyone, no party controls the record - pairs with its signed-attestation/Ed25519 design; a feeless fifth leg beside Base/Solana/XRPL/Stellar; offered nano-info (0.0005) read-side; disclosed public research. Verified OPEN, author dhyabi2, Nano+XNO in body.
